entities.summary: Santo Daime is a universalistic/syncretic religion founded in the 1930s in the Brazilian Amazonian state of Acre based on the teachings of Raimundo Irineu Serra, known as Mestre Irineu. Santo Daime incorporates elements of several religious or spiritual traditions, mainly folk Catholicism, Kardecist Spiritism, African animism and indigenous South American shamanism, including vegetalismo.
